description: Chinese engineering-management memory: purchasing approvals, code review, the National Day release freeze, hiring, remote work and the 2026 R&D budget. Evidence is the purchasing, code-review and remote-work policies, the 2025-12-18 annual budget meeting, the 2026-09-15 quarterly planning meeting that topped up the budget, and the freeze notice email. Hard parts: rules that apply only above a threshold or to some modules, two freeze claims that conflict with each other, a dated budget claim that stays true while the undated one does not, a cloud cap the memory derives by adding two numbers, and negation-character traps (无论, 非得, 非常, 未来, 不仅…而且).
